properties.name: The hub's check shows each member's reviewed source revision beside whether its design moved
properties.statement: upstream_status shows, for each pinned member, the source revision the hub last reviewed it at (the pin's `version`, re-declared when the hub catches up) beside the state of the member's export, so a hub keeping members in step with fast-moving source needs no fact convention of its own. reflow2 still does no fetching: the hub's own tooling fetches and re-declares the pin. The hub skill says how. Measured 2026-10-21: the pin already carries `source` and a required `version` (service.rs:5346-5349), but upstream_status prints the version only inside its `moved` sentence and never reads the export's taken_at (depends.rs:710-737).
